title: Pick Your Quant: A Field Guide to Local LLM Files
description: Everything behind the suffixes on Hugging Face: what quantization actually does, the full GGUF alphabet (Q4_K_M, Q6_K, IQ quants, UD, imatrix), the other formats (AWQ, GPTQ, EXL3, MLX, FP8, NVFP4, QAT), the fine-tune zoo (instruct, thinking, uncensored, flash, MTP), how to decode any repo, and a step-by-step framework for choosing the right model for your hardware — using Qwen3.8-27B as the running example.
